Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original editorial illustration for a minimalist personal essay website, light-mode variant.
Primary request: A small weathered wooden footbridge connects several low grassy islands across still water, with different branching footpaths beyond. A quiet visual metaphor for transferring learning between domains. No people, no robots, no neural-network clipart.
Style/medium: human, restrained French Impressionist oil-paint study, Claude Monet-inspired broken brushwork, soft atmospheric edges, visible subtle canvas texture, carefully observed light, elegant rather than ornamental.
Composition: landscape 3:2, one coherent scene, quiet balanced composition with generous breathing room; important objects fully in frame; designed to read at 600px wide, not a collage or triptych.
Lighting and palette: soft daylight, warm ivory and pale stone, muted sage, dusty blue, small ochre accents. Luminous but low saturation, gentle contrast for an off-white reading page.
Constraints: no text, lettering, typography, numbers, symbols, logos, watermark, UI, borders or frame; no photorealistic historical claims; no decorative swirls, galaxies, neon gradients, shiny 3D rendering. Keep the scene calm and meaningful.
